name: cookbook
description: Self-hosted family recipe app. Public portfolio repo; recipes stay on the NAS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cookbook/shared && npm run build -w @cookbook/api && npm run build -w @cookbook/mcp && npm run build -w @cookbook/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @cookbook/shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cookbook/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
